en: Changed automatic model switches after a flagged message to also cover model names Claude Code doesn't recognize, such as custom deployment names; set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK=1` to turn them off
zh: 变更在消息被标记后触发的自动模型切换，使其也覆盖 Claude Code 无法识别的模型名称（例如自定义部署名称）；设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK=1` 可关闭该切换
